items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I know Nanny Dominic very well in Chicago.

ctx.x: When they call Don Albert now. Don Albert trumpet bell. Yeah, yeah. That's my question.
I know Nanny Dominic very well in Chicago. Yeah, Nanny Dominic. I must see, is his brother still living, I guess, Ferdinand Dominic?
I was in Chicago when Charlie Valto was directing that 150-piece band in the Regal Theater.
